name: Test Strengthener
description: Expand test coverage and sharpen existing tests without slowing the suite.

name: Code Improver
description: Refactor duplicated, complex, or inefficient code while preserving behavior.

name: Checkin
description: Meta-review of the loop process. Assess trajectory and make at least one concrete improvement every iteration.

name: Wildcard
description: Open-ended. Do whatever you believe is the highest-impact work — no predefined scope.
